metadata.description: XdrLogRaider — Sentinel content (parsers, workbooks, analytic rules, hunting queries).

tags.name: description
tags.value: Compliance + pipeline drift events that occurred outside business hours (0900-1700 UTC) or on weekends. Attackers prefer making config changes off-hours to avoid review-window oversight.

properties.query:
// Note: drift EntityIds and AuditLogs target identifiers are not reliable to
// join at the record level. This query approximates by actor UPN within a
// time window of the drift event, filtered to Defender-related audit
// categories.
let drift = union
(MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1d)),
(MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 6h)),
(MDE_Drift_Exposure(7d, 1h));
let audits = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Category in (
'PolicyManagement',
'DefenderXdrSettings',
'Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps',
'Microsoft Defender for Identity',
'Unified audit',
'Azure Active Directory'
)
| extend ActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| where isnotempty(ActorUpn)
| project AuditTime = TimeGenerated, ActorUpn, Operation = OperationName, Category, AuditResult = Result;
drift
| join kind=leftouter (audits) on $left.TimeGenerated == $right.AuditTime
| extend ActorUpn = coalesce(ActorUpn, 'unknown (no correlating audit)')
| summarize DriftEvents = count(),
Streams = make_set(StreamName),
Operations = make_set(Operation)
by ActorUpn
| order by DriftEvents desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Correlate Defender XDR configuration drift with AuditLogs actor UPNs to surface "who changed what". Useful for post-incident retrospective and change-control reviews.

properties.query: Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_CustomDetections_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | extend Name = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).displayName), Enabled = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).isEnabled), Query = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).queryText), Schedule = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).schedule) | project EntityId, Name, Enabled, Schedule, Query, TimeGenerated

tags.name: description
tags.value: Full current text of all tenant custom detections — governance review artifact.

tags.name: description
tags.value: File/path/process exclusions ADDED to AV/EDR policy in the last 90 days. Attackers abuse exclusions for persistence — adding a path that hosts their malware effectively whitelists it from Defender scanning.

properties.displayName: MDE Live Response sessions without justification
properties.query: Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ActionCenter_CL' | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | extend Type = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).actionType), InvestigationId = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).investigationId) | where Type has "LiveResponse" and isempty(InvestigationId)

tags.name: description
tags.value: Live Response sessions initiated without a paired incident or investigation.

properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(30d, 1d) | where StreamName == "Defender_IdentityProtection_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_IdentityServiceAccounts_CL'"

tags.name: description
tags.value: Changes to MDI directory service account classifications.

properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(30d, 1d) | where StreamName == "Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL'" and ChangeType == "Added" | join kind=inner (Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId) on EntityId

tags.name: description
tags.value: Role assignments to accounts that previously had none.

properties.query: let drift = MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 1h); let suppressions = drift | where StreamName == "Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_SuppressionRules_CL'" and ChangeType == "Added"; let puaOff = drift | where StreamName == "Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_PUAConfig_CL'" and FieldName == "enabled" and NewValue == "false"; union suppressions, puaOff | summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | where Events >= 2

tags.name: description
tags.value:
Composite signal combining suppression-rule additions + PUA protection disables
in the same day. Both are legitimate admin actions on their own; together they
suggest an attacker quieting alerts before running unwanted code.

properties.query: MDE_Drift_Exposure(30d, 1h) | where StreamName == "Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmChokePoints_CL'" and ChangeType == "Added"

tags.name: description
tags.value: Nodes newly identified as chokepoints — they sit on many attack paths.

properties.description: The Defender Live Response unsigned-scripts policy was enabled tenant-wide. This allows arbitrary scripts to run on managed endpoints without code signing.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_LiveResponseConfig_CL'" | where FieldName == "allowUnsignedScripts" and NewValue == "true"

properties.description: A Defender for Identity domain controller sensor stopped reporting. Identity threat detection gap.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2d, 1h) | where StreamName == "Defender_IdentityProtection_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_DCCoverage_CL'" | where FieldName == "hasSensor" and OldValue == "true" and NewValue == "false"

properties.displayName: MDE portal config change outside business hours
properties.description: A tenant-configuration change was made outside 0900-1700 local time.
properties.query: union (MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m)), (MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m)) | extend HourOfDay = datetime_part("Hour", TimeGenerated) | where HourOfDay < 9 or HourOfDay >= 17

properties.description: Defender Potentially Unwanted Application protection was disabled tenant-wide.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_PUAConfig_CL'" | where FieldName == "enabled" and NewValue == "false"

properties.displayName: MDE RBAC role to unusual account
properties.description:
A Defender unified-RBAC role was assigned to a new principal. Alerts on "who got a new role" — not on every role-definition tweak.

Suggested operator response:
1. Confirm the principalId resolves to a known and sanctioned admin account.
2. If unknown: cross-reference SigninLogs and recent privilege grants for related activity.
3. If sanctioned: suppress this principal for 30 days via the rule's suppression settings.
properties.query:
MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 1d)
| where StreamName == "Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL'"
| where ChangeType == "Added"
| where FieldName == "principalId" or FieldName == "principalName"

properties.description:
A new Event Hub or Storage target was configured for Defender telemetry streaming. Possible exfiltration channel.

Note: Microsoft has signaled the upstream streaming-API endpoint may be retired in favor of newer Defender XDR streaming feeds. Heartbeat diagnostics surface 403/404 if the endpoint becomes unreachable. See docs/STREAMS.md for current endpoint-availability tracking.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Maintenance(1h, 10m) | where StreamName == "Defender_StreamingApi_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_StreamingApiConfig_CL'" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.description: An existing alert suppression rule had its scope widened — may silence legitimate alerts.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_SuppressionRules_CL'" | where ChangeType == "Modified" | where FieldName in ("scope","conditions","machineGroup")

properties.description: Defender Tamper Protection was disabled. This allows malicious tools to modify Defender settings directly.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_AdvancedFeatures_CL'" | where EntityId has "Tamper" | where FieldName == "Enabled" and NewValue == "false"

properties.description: A new URL, IP, file hash, or sender was added to the Defender tenant allow-list, bypassing blocks.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_TenantAllowBlock_CL'" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector auth chain failure - elevated AADSTS exception rate
properties.description:
XdrLogRaider's portal authentication chain (TOTP / passkey / ESTS / sccauth /
XSRF-TOKEN exchange) is producing exceptions at elevated rate, indicating:
- service account credentials need rotation (rare; admin-managed per directive 39)
- TOTP seed mismatch
- Entra Conditional Access policy change blocking the SP
- portal API auth contract change

Per directive 38 + B8 in .claude/plans/immutable-splashing-waffle.md.
Operator-enabled (ships disabled per Sentinel Solution best practice).

Triage in docs/AUTH.md + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Auth chain failure" section.
properties.query:
// Filter to XdrLogRaider Function App App Insights, then to AuthChain.* exception classes.
// Threshold: >3 AuthChain.* exceptions in 1h window (more than transient ESTS flake).
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| extend ErrorClass = tostring(Properties.ErrorClass)
| where ErrorClass startswith "AuthChain."
| summarize FailureCount = count(), Stages = make_set(ErrorClass) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 3
| project TimeGenerated, FailureCount, Stages

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector auth chain staleness - silent hang detection
properties.description:
XdrLogRaider's auth chain has stopped emitting AuthChain.Completed events,
indicating a SILENT hang somewhere in the auth flow (Get-EntraEstsAuth or
Get-DefenderSccauth). Heartbeat may still fire from Connector-Heartbeat
function (timer trigger), but actual data polls are dead.

Different from XdrOps-AuthChainFailure which alerts on >3 AuthChain.*
exception count: this rule alerts on ABSENCE of AuthChain.Completed
events. The two are complementary — failure rule catches "noisy
failures", staleness rule catches "silent death".

Phase J D'.3 (2026-05-04). Operator-enabled (ships disabled per Sentinel
Solution best practice). Triage:
- Check FA in Azure portal: is it Running? Are functions firing?
- Check Application Insights: are there AppRequests (function
invocations) but no AppEvents (AuthChain.Completed)?
- Try Connect-DefenderPortal locally with same service-account
credentials — does it succeed?
See docs/AUTH.md + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Auth chain hang" section.

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector stream stale - no ingest beyond expected cadence
properties.description:
An XdrLogRaider stream has not ingested any rows for >2x its expected cadence,
indicating a poll failure, schema drift, portal API change, or auth chain issue.

Per directive 38 + B7 in .claude/plans/immutable-splashing-waffle.md.
Operator-enabled (ships disabled per Sentinel Solution best practice).

Thresholds (2x cadence margin):
Defender-ActionCenter-Refresh    (10m cadence) -> alert if >20m stale
Defender-XspmGraph-Refresh       (1h  cadence) -> alert if >2h  stale
Defender-Configuration-Refresh   (6h  cadence) -> alert if >12h stale
Defender-Inventory-Refresh       (1d  cadence) -> alert if >2d  stale
Defender-Maintenance-Refresh     (1w  cadence) -> alert if >2w  stale

Triage in docs/RUNBOOK.md "Stream stale" section.
properties.query:
let cadenceLimits = datatable(FunctionName: string, MaxStaleMin: long)
[
"Defender-ActionCenter-Refresh",   20,
"Defender-XspmGraph-Refresh",      120,
"Defender-Configuration-Refresh",  720,
"Defender-Inventory-Refresh",      2880,
"Defender-Maintenance-Refresh",    20160,
"Connector-Heartbeat",             10
];
XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize LastSeenUtc = max(TimeGenerated) by FunctionName
| join kind=inner cadenceLimits on FunctionName
| extend StaleMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeenUtc)
| where StaleMin > MaxStaleMin
| project FunctionName, LastSeenUtc, StaleMin, MaxStaleMin

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector DLQ depth or age exceeds operator threshold
properties.description:
XdrLogRaider's ingest dead-letter queue (Storage Table xdrIngestDlq) has
rows that have been waiting too long OR queue depth exceeded operational
threshold, indicating sustained DCE 5xx/429 backpressure.


Operator-enabled (ships disabled per Sentinel Solution best practice).

Thresholds (operator-tuneable in query):
- Depth >100 entries OR
- Oldest entry >2h (> 1 poll cycle for fast tier)

Triage in docs/RUNBOOK.md "DLQ backlog" section.
Auto-drain: Pop-XdrIngestDlq runs at start of every Defender-*-Refresh poll
to retry stuck batches with TTL eviction.
properties.query:
// DLQ depth metric is emitted by Pop-XdrIngestDlq on each poll cycle.
// Per-stream cardinality bounded by manifest stream count (47).
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where Name in ("xdr.ingest.dlq_depth", "xdr.ingest.dlq_oldest_age_seconds")
| summarize MaxValue = max(Value) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend AlertReason = case(
Name == "xdr.ingest.dlq_depth"               and MaxValue > 100,    "DLQ depth >100 entries",
Name == "xdr.ingest.dlq_oldest_age_seconds"  and MaxValue > 7200,   "DLQ oldest entry >2h",
""
)
| where AlertReason != ""
| project TimeGenerated, Name, MaxValue, AlertReason

properties.description:
XdrLogRaider's ingest pipeline emits `xdr.ingest.row_count_per_hour` per
stream. This rule detects when any stream's hourly row count exceeds
3× its 7-day rolling baseline — a cost-budget gate that catches:

1. Operator-driven schema explosion (e.g., adding wildcard PathParams that
fan out 100x).
2. Tenant-side breach scenario (e.g., suddenly 10k device-control policy
rows where there were 50 — operator should investigate intent).
3. Connector regression that deduplicates incorrectly and blasts every
row twice.
4. ProjectionMap mis-configuration causing row multiplication
(e.g., property-bag flatten on the wrong field).

Suppresses for 4h after first fire to prevent alert flood when the spike
is legitimate (e.g., onboarding a new fleet).

Operator-enabled (ships `enabled: false` per Sentinel Solution best practice).
D'.49 in v0.1.0 GA plan: cost-budget runtime gate.

Triage in docs/RUNBOOK.md "Row-volume spike" section.

The XdrLogRaider service account (UPN parameter $(SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN)) has
signed in from an anomalous location/IP/device or is being targeted by
credential-stuffing.

Service account = connector security boundary. Even though XdrLogRaider grants
Defender XDR READER, sign-in compromise = data exfil risk.

Operator MUST enable post-deploy (ships disabled). UPN bound at ARM deploy
via SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN parameter. Detects: new country/IP not in 30d baseline;
sign-in outside poll cadence; failed-then-success (cred stuffing); MFA bypass.
Triage: docs/RUNBOOK.md.

properties.displayName: MDE XSPM new attack path discovered
properties.description:
A new attack path was identified in Defender Exposure Management (XSPM) — a route from an entry point to a critical asset.
Note: the Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL' stream is opt-in. The rule is deployed but stays dormant until the stream is enabled in the connector configuration.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Exposure(7d, 1h) | where StreamName == "Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL'" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.displayName: MDE XSPM path to critical asset
properties.description:
An attack path terminates at a device tagged Critical. Immediate remediation candidate.
Note: the Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL' stream is opt-in. The rule is deployed but stays dormant until the stream is enabled in the connector configuration.
properties.query: Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | extend TargetCriticality = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).targetCriticality) | where TargetCriticality == "Critical" | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
